title: 混合检索 RRF 融合：多排名融合对比单一检索
expected_output:
检索器A单独排名 = [3, 1, 4, 2, 5]
检索器B单独排名 = [2, 5, 1, 3, 4]
RRF融合排名 = [2, 3, 1, 5, 4]
doc5 在A名次=5 在B名次=2
doc5 是否进入融合Top3 = False
code:
k = 60
list_a = [3, 1, 4, 2, 5]
list_b = [2, 5, 1, 3, 4]

def rrf(rank_list):
    s = {}
    for rank, doc in enumerate(rank_list, start=1):
        s[doc] = s.get(doc, 0.0) + 1.0 / (k + rank)
    return s

sa = rrf(list_a)
sb = rrf(list_b)
fused = {}
for d in set(sa) | set(sb):
    fused[d] = sa.get(d, 0.0) + sb.get(d, 0.0)
ranked = [d for d, _ in sorted(fused.items(), key=lambda x: -x[1])]
print('检索器A单独排名 =', list_a)
print('检索器B单独排名 =', list_b)
print('RRF融合排名 =', ranked)
print('doc5 在A名次=%d 在B名次=%d' % (list_a.index(5) + 1, list_b.index(5) + 1))
print('doc5 是否进入融合Top3 =', 5 in ranked[:3])
